description: Energy Transmitted by IWPP (MWh) is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset presents the monthly energy transmitted, measured in megawatt-hours (MWh), from Qatar's Independent Water and Power Producers (IWPP). It includes production data from several major plants such as Ras Abu Fontas B, B1, B2, Ras Laffan A and B, Mesaieed, Ras Girtas, Umm Al Houl, and Siraj1 solar plant. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are electricity, energy, transmission, IWPP, MWh. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
